text:
sofia: Quick heads-up — PR #7128 (kv-cache: regen + memfix) is still waiting on approvals. Target deploy window 21:00 PT / 04:00 UTC. We need two reviewers to sign off before we can cut the hotfix. I'm the owner, will coordinate fixes.

ash: I can take a look now, running tests locally.

liam: I left one comment about a flaky test in kv_cache_test.py — looks like a timing assumption. If that's fixed I'm fine to approve. :eyes: 

sofia: thanks @liam — repro steps?

liam: add this to test setup: `time.sleep(0.02)` makes it flake less reliably; I'll paste minimal patch in a sec.

june: I can be second approver but will wait for CI green. If @ash lgtm + ci passes I can stamp.

release-bot: Reminder: deploy window opens in 40m. Please ensure changelog and rollback plan in the PR description. :timer_clock: 

ash: quick update — running full test, one unrelated integration flake, pushing small fixture change now. PR updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/passing/pull/7128

sofia: added rollback notes and canary % in the PR description. If CI is green by T-10m we'll merge and tag rc.

liam: pushed a tiny test cleanup, marking LGTM from me. :shipit: 

ash: CI passed on latest run, leaving LGTM. merging after midnight cutoff? (21:00 PT is our window)

june: marking LGTM as well. two approvals now. I'll be on-call during rollout.

sofia: Awesome — merging in 2 minutes. Will monitor logs and latency dashboards. Thanks team :tada:
